data.rationale: The proposal gets the goal, email recipient, subject and body template right, but it omits the blog parameter and the new-tab visit to the blog for the latest post, and it never says to switch to the Mail tab. It also adds a "Users" filter step, ends with Send instead of Discard (which contradicts "do not send"), and treats recipient_email as a parameter when it is fixed. A builder couldn't tell where to find the latest post, and the Send step is unsafe.
